feature_contract.goal: Reduce CPU memory bandwidth spent duplicating unreferenced indexed XYZRHW smoke/sand/decal vertex spans for both eyes without changing referenced vertices or stereo fallback semantics.
feature_contract.acceptance: For indexed masks with at least 64 vertices and at most 25% referenced, copy only contiguous referenced runs. Preserve full memcpy for unindexed/dense draws and source-wide memcpy on atomic full-reprojection fallback; both eye transforms must continue to visit all referenced vertices. Regression verifier and complete x86 source/link gates must pass.
feature_contract.runtime_metrics: No real Quest3/VDXR frame time measurements; a source-level reduction in copy bytes is not a proven FPS gain.

acceptance_results.evidence: src/vr/d3d9/stereo_renderer_r30.cpp selects sparse indexed-mask runs at <=25% coverage with >=64 vertex span; dense and unindexed whole-span copies unchanged.
The original full-source memcpy in a failed full-reprojection path and both-eye fallback remain; no modifications to semantic classification, SkyGlow, input/FFB or transport.
tools/verify_vr_r30_eye_tail_hotpath.py adds sparse-copy structural guard, parity for 120 cases, and checks original whole-span rollback; policy job #114664279161 SUCCESS.
